title: The coord panel keeps an ask open for an absent item, an unconfirmed provisional answer and an unloadable backlog
goal: mon_coord.gate_settled keeps an ask open when its item is absent from the panel root's backlog and while the gate's answer is an agent's unconfirmed provisional one (by agent); without_settled leaves every ask open and the coord panel ok when Backlog(root) raises Refused or ExtensionError.

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_coord,bl_base
B=type('B',(),{'items':{}})
absent=mon_coord.gate_settled('Gate g1 of ST-zzzzzzzz',B())
mk=lambda by:type('B',(),{'items':{'ST-zzzzzzzz':{'status':'open','gates':[{'id':'g1','kind':'provisional','answer':'x','by':by}]}}})()
agent=mon_coord.gate_settled('Gate g1 of ST-zzzzzzzz',mk('agent'))
oper=mon_coord.gate_settled('Gate g1 of ST-zzzzzzzz',mk('operator'))
def boom(*a,**k):
    raise bl_base.Refused('x')
bl_base.load_settings=lambda r:None
bl_base.Backlog=boom
asks=[{'id':'a1','ref':'k1'}]
kept=mon_coord.without_settled(asks,[{'key':'k1','value':'Gate g1 of ST-zzzzzzzz'}],'.')
sys.exit(0 if (not absent and not agent and oper and kept==asks) else 1)
